answer: Reaching eligibility takes 69 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. The violet register is checked at draw time, lagoon lists the eligible set, and spiral seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 69 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 39 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
